title: Pass the Pillow
summary: In a line of n people numbered from 1 to n, the first person starts with a pillow.
statement: In a line of n people numbered from 1 to n, the first person starts with a pillow. Every second, the pillow is passed to the next person. When it reaches the end, the direction reverses. Given n and time, find the person holding the pillow after time seconds.
constraints: People are numbered one through n in a line.
The pillow moves one person per second, reversing direction at either endpoint.
Person one holds it at time zero; return the holder after time seconds.
hints: One complete forward-and-back cycle lasts 2*(n-1) seconds.
Reduce time modulo that cycle length.
Offsets below n move forward from person one; larger offsets reflect backward as 2*n-1-offset.
Periodic motion repeats exactly after returning to person one with forward direction, so the reduced formula matches every time.
editorial: Periodic motion repeats exactly after returning to person one with forward direction, so the reduced formula matches every time.

tests.explanation: The holders are 1,2,3,4,3,2, so person two holds it after five seconds.
After two forward passes, person three holds the pillow.
